meta.scope: Mexico batch 7 (15 candidates) — agriculture, demography, ICT/household, environment (CEEM), culture satellite, Banxico balance of payments & international reserves, additional labour/housing. Push toward completion of core Mexico inventory.

candidates.title: Censo Agropecuario / Agricultural Census
candidates.description: Periodic census of agricultural, livestock and forestry activities (most recent major exercise 2022). Provides structural data on land use, production units, labour and output. Declared Information of National Interest; methodology explicitly grounded in the LSNIEG.
candidates.notes: Ninth agricultural census in Mexican history. 2022 results: ~103.6 million ha with agricultural/forestry use or vocation; ~27 million people in agricultural labour force. Methodology documents open with LSNIEG legal foundation (same pattern as population and economic censuses).

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional Agropecuaria (ENA) / National Agricultural Survey
candidates.description: Sample survey providing more frequent updates on agricultural producers and production between censuses. Complements the Agricultural Census with continuous monitoring of the sector.
candidates.notes: Bridge survey between agricultural censuses. Results and methodology workshops are published (e.g. ENA 2025). Used for sector monitoring and policy.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de la Dinámica Demográfica (ENADID) / National Survey of Demographic Dynamics
candidates.description: Periodic demographic survey (roughly every five years once designated Información de Interés Nacional) covering fertility, mortality, internal and international migration, reproductive preferences, contraceptive use, nuptiality, maternal-child health, and related household/housing topics. Complements the Population Census.
candidates.notes: Key intercensal demographic source. Series since 1992; 2023 edition is the latest full exercise. Explicitly part of the SNIEG and used for population projections and policy design.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional sobre Disponibilidad y Uso de Tecnologías de la Información en los Hogares (ENDUTIH)
candidates.description: Household survey on availability and use of information and communication technologies (internet, computers, mobile phones, etc.). Annual or near-annual.
candidates.notes: Principal source for digital-inclusion and ICT-access indicators at household level. Complements enterprise ICT surveys and is widely cited in digital-economy analysis.

candidates.title: Cuentas Económicas y Ecológicas de México (CEEM) / Economic and Ecological Accounts of Mexico
candidates.description: Environmental-economic accounts producing the environmentally adjusted Net Domestic Product (Producto Interno Neto Ecológico / PINE) and the total costs of resource depletion and environmental degradation (emissions, soil, untreated wastewater, solid waste, forest, groundwater, hydrocarbons).
candidates.notes: 2024 results: PINE ≈ 25.7 trillion pesos (76.6% of market-price GDP); total environmental costs ≈ 1.38 trillion pesos (4.1% of GDP), dominated by air emissions. Implements SEEA-style accounting within the Mexican national-accounts framework.

candidates.title: Cuenta Satélite de la Cultura de México (CSCM) / Satellite Account of Culture of Mexico
candidates.description: Satellite account measuring the economic contribution of cultural activities (production, income, employment, supply and use, expenditure). Follows SNA 2008, UNESCO culture-statistics framework and Ibero-American guidance.
candidates.notes: One of the suite of Mexican satellite accounts (alongside tourism, health, unpaid work, environment, non-profit, housing). Provides value-added, employment and expenditure by cultural domain and by state.

candidates.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
candidates.description: Quarterly (and annual) balance-of-payments statistics compiled by Banco de México according to international standards. Covers current account, capital account, financial account and reserves. Methodological note published by Banxico.
candidates.notes: Core external-accounts product. Complements INEGI merchandise trade statistics with services, primary income, secondary income (including remittances) and financial-account flows. Regular press releases give the quarterly aggregates and ratios to GDP.

candidates.title: Reservas Internacionales Netas / Net International Reserves
candidates.description: Weekly (and higher-frequency) stock of Banco de México’s net international reserves. Published in the weekly balance-sheet communiqué and used as a key external-vulnerability and monetary-policy indicator.
candidates.notes: High-frequency Banxico series. Levels in mid-2026 around USD 255 billion. Appears in the weekly Estado de Cuenta and in the balance-of-payments financial account (change in reserve assets).

candidates.title: Tipo de cambio peso-dólar (fixación Banxico) / Peso-dollar exchange rate (Banxico fix)
candidates.description: Official daily fixing of the peso/US dollar exchange rate published by Banco de México for settlement of obligations denominated in foreign currency payable in Mexico.
candidates.notes: Benchmark exchange-rate series used throughout financial markets, national accounts (for conversion) and policy analysis. Published daily on business days.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Vivienda (ENH) / National Housing Survey (or related continuous housing modules)
candidates.description: Household survey / modules providing detailed information on housing characteristics, tenure, services and quality. Complements census housing data and feeds the housing-related deprivations in multidimensional poverty measurement.
candidates.notes: Supports continuous monitoring of housing conditions between censuses and is linked to the ‘calidad y espacios de la vivienda’ and ‘servicios básicos en la vivienda’ dimensions of multidimensional poverty.

candidates.title: ENIGH — Ingresos por transferencias / Transfer income (from ENIGH)
candidates.description: Component of ENIGH that captures current transfers received by households (government social programmes, remittances, private transfers, etc.). Central for analysing the impact of Bienestar pensions and other social transfers on household income and poverty.
candidates.notes: Direct statistical counterpart to the programme-side beneficiary counts of the Pensión para el Bienestar and related schemes. Used in distributional and poverty-impact analysis.

candidates.title: Cuadros de Oferta y Utilización (COU) / Supply and Use Tables
candidates.description: Annual (and benchmark) Supply and Use Tables that form the core balancing framework of the Sistema de Cuentas Nacionales de México. Source of GDP by production, expenditure and income approaches at detailed product and industry level.
candidates.notes: Foundational tables from which many satellite accounts and short-term indicators are derived or benchmarked. Explicitly referenced in tourism, health and other satellite-account methodologies.

candidates.title: Producto Interno Bruto Trimestral / Quarterly GDP
candidates.description: Quarterly national-accounts estimates of GDP (production, expenditure and income approaches) consistent with the annual SCNM. Principal short-term macroeconomic aggregate.
candidates.notes: Headline quarterly GDP series. Linked to IGAE, IMAI and the full annual accounts. Widely used by Banxico, SHCP and markets.

candidates.title: Ingresos por remesas familiares / Family remittance income
candidates.description: Monthly statistics of family remittances received from abroad, published by Banco de México as part of the secondary-income component of the balance of payments and as a standalone high-frequency series.
candidates.notes: Major secondary-income flow and important household-income source, especially in certain states. Appears in the balance-of-payments secondary-income account and is analysed alongside ENIGH transfer income.

candidates.title: Anuario Estadístico y Geográfico por Entidad Federativa / Statistical and Geographic Yearbook by Federal Entity
candidates.description: Annual compendium of key statistical and geographic indicators for each federal entity, drawing together data from multiple INEGI programmes and other official sources.
candidates.notes: Useful secondary product that packages state-level indicators already produced by primary programmes. Serves as a convenient entry point for entity-level analysis and is itself a published annual series.

proposed_edges.basis: Methodology explicitly cites the LSNIEG as the legal foundation for conducting the agricultural census.
Environmental-economic accounts are constructed as a satellite / adjustment to the core national accounts.
Culture satellite account follows SNA 2008 and is integrated with the Mexican national-accounts framework.
Merchandise trade component of the current account draws on / is consistent with INEGI merchandise trade statistics.
Quarterly GDP is the short-term expression of the annual national-accounts system.
Transfer-income module is an integral part of ENIGH.
